changelog: Adds context-only compatibility notes for PFS experimental support and exact reported version combinations.
Updates the TitleDir/AppInstallAll rule to reflect the maintainer commit that restored hooks and closed issues #145/#147.
Expands scanner guidance for scanpath, scan_depth, source layout and manual.lst based on ShadowMountPlus 1.7 documentation.
Adds a rule for duplicate Title IDs and clarifies that a duplicate source is not proof of corruption.
Embeds English rule translations so verified knowledge-base updates can add/edit rules without rebuilding the app.
Adds report follow-up fields and compatibility/timeline metadata.

privacy.downloads: Only the diagnostic knowledge-base JSON is downloaded after user confirmation.
privacy.uploads: No logs, reports, console IP addresses, or personal data are uploaded by the updater.
